body.justification: The theorem gives exact conditional post-selection coverage uniformly on the explicitly separated moment subclass where every candidate endpoint has nonzero first-order variance.
body.gap: Ji--Lei--Spector already provide generic selection-valid inference, and Lin et al. provide a fixed-target quadratic-COT central limit theorem; this Gaussian specialization supplies the endpoint influence map and its exact degeneracy criterion, not a new generic selection principle.
body.consumer: Analysts can report uncertainty for the held-out endpoint selected by any first-sample budget rule on \(\Theta_+(\nu_*)\).
